# Vendored libraries

Served from this site so the page runs no third-party code next to the visitor's API key.
Fetched from jsDelivr by `build.py vendor`; `SOURCES.json` lists each file's source and checksums (the SDK's files differ from jsDelivr's only in their import paths, which point at these siblings).

| Package | Version | License | Home |
|---|---|---|---|
| `react` | 18.3.1 | MIT | https://reactjs.org/ |
| `react-dom` | 18.3.1 | MIT | https://reactjs.org/ |
| `@anthropic-ai/sdk` | 1.7.0 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript#readme |
| `@opentelemetry/api` | 1.10.0 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-js/tree/main/api |
| `standardwebhooks` | 1.1.1 | MIT | https://github.com/standard-webhooks/standard-webhooks/tree/main/libraries/javascript |
| `@stablelib/base64` | 1.0.1 | MIT | https://github.com/StableLib/stablelib/tree/master/packages/base64 |
| `fast-sha256` | 1.3.0 | Unlicense | https://github.com/dchest/fast-sha256-js#readme |
